Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the use of public funds for lobbying.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of public facilities for lobbying; andamending RCW 44.04.170.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 44.04.170 and 1999 c 153 s 59 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It shall be the duty of each association of municipal corporationsor municipal officers, which is recognized by law and utilized as anofficial agency for the coordination of the policies and/oradministrative programs of municipal corporations, to submitbiennially, or ((oftener)) more often as necessary, to the governor andto the legislature the joint recommendations of such participatingmunicipalities regarding changes which would affect the efficiency ofsuch municipal corporations. No public funds may be used directly orindirectly for lobbying. Such associations shall include but shall notbe limited to the Washington state association of fire commissioners,a state association of water/wastewater districts, and the Washingtonstate school directors' association.
